segments.he: אֶחָדאָמַר שֶׁמַּה שֶּׁחָלַם לוֹ שֶׁנָּפְלוּ שִׁנָּיו מְרַמֵּז עַל חָכְמוֹת שֶׁלּוֹ שֶׁיִּתְבַּטְּלוּ, וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי  לוֹ אַדְּרַבָּה הַשְּׁטוּת שֶׁלְּךָ יִתְבַּטֵּל כִּי שֵׁן הַסֶּלַע תַּרְגּוּמוֹ חֹזֶק וְכוּ' (אָמַר הַמַּעְתִּיק  עַיֵּן  מִדְרָשׁ  רַבָּה בְּמִדְבָּר פָּרָשָׁה ג' אֵין שֵׁן אֶלָּא לְשׁוֹן חֹזֶק וְכוּ'). (רְצוֹנוֹ  לוֹמַר  בְּדֶרֶךְ  צַחוּת  וַהֲלָצָה  כִּי בִּמְדִינָתֵנוּ קוֹרְאִין לְאִישׁ שׁוֹטֶה חוֹיזֶק):
segments.en: (16.) He said previously: "Sometimes an illness, G-d forbid, breaks out in the world — and then it goes and spreads from one to another — called unter gang [epidemic]. And there is a distinction in this matter — for there is one person to whom the illness reaches from Heaven itself directly. And there is one person to whom the illness does not come directly — only he receives the illness, G-d forbid, from his companion. And there is a distinction between them: the one to whom the illness is sent directly — he has this illness with all the symptoms and details of that illness, for there are several symptoms to each type of illness, G-d save us..."
